reasons: Cited Sections 8.2–8.3 match the preferred position: successive twelve-month (not multi-year) renewals, Customer opt-out on thirty days' notice, a sixty-day Vendor reminder with a pro-Customer extension if it is missed, and uplift capped at the lesser of US CPI and three percent.
Deterministic check confirms the non-renewal notice window (30 days) is well inside both the preferred (≤30) and fallback (≤60) thresholds, and the price cap is below the 5% fallback ceiling.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or counterparty comment was proposed; the paragraphs are returned unchanged and the rationale correctly records why no negotiation issue arises.
